description: Narrative claims shown alongside charts. Every note is computed from the canonical dashboard data files listed in its sources, so no editorial number is hand-typed.
dataSource: Derived from official SBP, PBS, FBR and Finance Division data

inflation.cpiPath.text: Headline CPI inflation peaked at 38.0% year-on-year in May 2023 and stood at 11.1% in June 2026. This is the most widely tracked inflation measure in Pakistan.
inflation.cpiPath.derivation: Maximum and latest observation of the national CPI year-on-year series across 60 months from July 2021.

exchange-rate.depreciation.text: The rupee's monthly average moved from ₨153.08/USD in April 2021 to its weakest monthly average of ₨297.75 in September 2023 — a 48.6% loss of value against the dollar. It averaged ₨278.58 in June 2026, 6.4% stronger than that low.
exchange-rate.depreciation.derivation: Strongest and weakest monthly average PKR/USD interbank rates in the published archive from January 2021; depreciation measured as the fall in dollar value of the rupee.

reserves.recovery.text: Across the published window, total liquid reserves were lowest at $18.90bn at end-September 2025 and stood at $22.67bn at the week ending 2026-07-17, of which $17.26bn is held by the SBP.
reserves.recovery.derivation: Minimum and latest total (SBP plus commercial banks) across the 16 published observations from end-June 2025.

trade.deficit.text: The monthly goods trade deficit was widest at $4.07bn in June 2022. In June 2026 exports of $2.60bn against imports of $6.15bn left a deficit of $3.55bn.
trade.deficit.derivation: Largest and latest monthly balance in the SBP balance-of-payments goods series covering 66 months.

sources.label: Exports and Imports (BOP basis) - archive series

fdi.annualContext.text: Net FDI in FY2026 was $1.64bn ($3.57bn of inflows against $1.93bn of outflows) — below the series peak of $2.78bn in FY2018, and the strongest since FY2025.
fdi.annualContext.derivation: Latest completed fiscal year compared against every other year in the annual net FDI series from FY2017.

services.itShare.text: IT & telecom exports of $4.18bn in Jul-May FY26 were 46.0% of all services exports and up 20.2% on Jul-May FY25.
services.itShare.derivation: IT & telecom credit as a share of total services credit for the same fiscal-year-to-date window, compared with the same window a year earlier.

fiscal.revenueGap.text: In FY25 total revenue of ₨18.0tn covered 74.5% of total expenditure of ₨24.2tn, leaving a primary surplus of ₨2.72tn. All fiscal figures are for Pakistan's July–June fiscal year.
fiscal.revenueGap.derivation: Total revenue divided by total expenditure for the latest fiscal year in the SBP summary of public finance, with the reported primary balance for the same year.

sources.institution: Ministry of Finance, Government of Pakistan
sources.label: Federal Budget and Fiscal Operations

fiscal.debtService.text: Debt servicing alone is budgeted at ₨8.05tn in FY2026-27 — 39.1% of gross federal revenue and 68.5% of the net revenue the federal government actually keeps after transfers to the provinces.
fiscal.debtService.derivation: Budgeted interest ("markup") payments divided by budgeted gross and net federal revenue, as presented on 2026-06-12.
